rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Analyzes URLs across seven dimensions including redirect behavior, brand impersonation, domain age, SSL validity, parking detection, URL structure, and DNS enrichment. Returns structured signals with configurable scoring rather than binary verdicts, enabling context-specific decisions. Requires an API key from unphurl.com.
